destination.name: Nambucca Heads
destination.tagline: A river-mouth town between Coffs Harbour and Port Macquarie, with clifftop lookouts over the Nambucca estuary.
destination.description: Nambucca Heads is a coastal town of about 6,700 people on the Mid-North Coast, a little north of the halfway mark between Sydney and Brisbane. Captain Cook Lookout at the end of Parkes Street looks over the Nambucca River mouth, and Wikivoyage also lists a local history museum. To the north, Urunga is where the Bellinger and Kalang rivers meet the sea, and a boardwalk there leads to Hungry Head Beach.
whyVisit: Walk the Urunga boardwalk to Hungry Head Beach
Look over the river mouth from Captain Cook Lookout

goodToKnow.title: Train stops here
goodToKnow.detail: Nambucca Heads station gets two northbound services a day from Sydney; the town is 4 km off the Pacific Motorway.

goodToKnow.title: Short visitor centre hours
goodToKnow.detail: Nambucca Valley Visitor Information Centre on Riverside Drive is open Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 9am to 2pm, and Wednesday 9am to noon.

goodToKnow.title: Swim where the lifeguards are
goodToKnow.detail: Hungry Head Beach is largely untouched, with lifeguards only at its car-accessible southern end.
